from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFeature(BaseModel):
    """Extracted features from a single judgment document summary for matching against results."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., '1' from Document 1)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court that issued the ruling")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Category of the case (e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政')")
    procedure_stage: str | None = Field(description="Procedural stage (e.g., '二审', '再审', '执行')")
    parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="Names of key parties (appellants, respondents, applicants)")
    outcome: str | None = Field(description="Core ruling action (e.g., '驳回上诉', '准许撤回', '驳回申请')")
    fee_amount: float | None = Field(description="Litigation fee amount if explicitly mentioned")
    fee_bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who is responsible for paying the litigation fees")
    specific_case_numbers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Case numbers or specific dates mentioned")
    verdict_amounts: list[float] | None = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts awarded or paid")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFeature]
